highlights.title: Storylens — event-driven AI backend
highlights.desc: Transformed articles into visual summaries through an event-driven LLM pipeline; semantic prompt caching drove sub-second p50 responses.
highlights.context: Bottleneck: every article re-ran the full LLM pipeline. Trade-off: accepted eventual staleness for latency and cost.

highlights.title: High-throughput microservices
highlights.desc: Operated 4 core microservices serving low-latency football content to high-concurrency global traffic under strict production SLAs.
highlights.context: Owned uptime and latency, not just endpoints.

highlights.title: Data-pipeline fault tolerance
highlights.desc: Architected 10 data parsers on the ELK stack across AWS ECS and Lambda.
highlights.context: Peak-event bursts dropped feeds; async queuing + exponential backoff eliminated the loss.

highlights.title: Publisher API integration
highlights.desc: Managed distributed API integrations and high-volume widget delivery; presented the in-image widget architecture at DMEXCO.

highlights.title: Banglapapers semantic search
highlights.desc: Architected an AI news platform aggregating 10+ publisher feeds with OpenSearch semantic indexing.
highlights.context: Tuned indexing for sub-100ms query latency.

highlights.title: SocialDesk automation
highlights.desc: Engineered an automated content-processing and image-generation pipeline via direct article scraping and workflow execution.
highlights.context: Removed manual developer cycles from content prep.

highlights.title: Widget Builder (internal ops)
highlights.desc: Built an internal widget-generation engine so non-engineers ship production-ready widgets.
highlights.context: Cut a repetitive 30-minute manual workflow to under two minutes.

highlights.title: Observability dashboard
highlights.desc: Developed central monitoring aggregating API health, ad delivery, cost insights, and daily operational reports.
highlights.context: Used logs and metrics to diagnose production behavior.

highlights.title: Inquiry System
highlights.desc: Designed optimized SQL queries across business units and built reporting structures under custom relational schemas.
